title: fix(channel): drop the CHANNEL_PASSWORD_REQUEST handler, the client remembers the channel
expect: CHANNEL_PASSWORD_REQUEST|prompt(ed|s)? (for|the)|asks? for the password|every login|each login
why: Reverse of b0aea00. The client rejoins a remembered custom channel at login without the password and asks for it; without this handler every player gets a password prompt at every login (seen live 2026-11-08).
